name: baton
description: Work board for Claude Code: auto handoff + compaction before the prompt cache expires, lane overview, layered memory, auto notes, nudges and guards / 工作看板：快取將過期時自動交接並壓縮、lane 一覽、分層記憶、自動整理筆記、防呆提醒與守門

language.title: Language / 語言
language.description: Board, handoff instructions and briefings. auto: Claude Code's language setting, else LANG / 看板、交接指示與說明的語言。auto：依 Claude Code 的 language 設定，沒設則看 LANG

memory_dir.title: Memory folder / 記憶資料夾
memory_dir.description: Folder the Memory tab reads. Supports {config} (~/.claude), {project} (project slug), {root} (project root), ~; relative to the project root / 記憶分頁讀取的資料夾。可用 {config}、{project}、{root}、~；相對路徑以專案根目錄為準

handoff_path.title: Handoff document / 交接文件
handoff_path.description: File auto-handoff writes and the Progress tab shows. Same placeholders as above; override per project in {config}/projects/{project}/baton.json / 自動交接寫入、進度分頁顯示的檔案。可用同上的代號；個別專案可用 {config}/projects/{project}/baton.json 覆寫

brief_on_start.title: Brief on start / 自動接續交接文件
brief_on_start.description: Attach the handoff mechanism and document to the first prompt of a new session or after compaction / 新 session 或壓縮後的第一個 prompt，自動附上交接機制說明與交接文件

launcher_button.title: Launcher button / 輸入框上方的看板按鈕
launcher_button.description: Show a board button above the prompt box while the board is closed / 看板關著時，在輸入框上方顯示一顆按鈕，點了打開看板

cache_ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL / 提示快取時效
cache_ttl.description: Basis for the countdown; no auto-handoff at 5m. The value reported on model switch wins / 倒數依據；5m 時不自動交接。切換模型時以引擎告知的值為準

away_hours.title: Away cutoff (hours) / 離開多久後不再自動交接（小時）
away_hours.description: Skip auto-handoff when the last input is older than this / 最後一次輸入超過這麼久，快取到期前就不再自動交接

retry_nudge.title: Repeated-failure nudge / 重複失敗提醒
retry_nudge.description: When a tool fails twice in a row for the same reason, ask Claude to find the cause instead of retrying as is / 同一個工具連續兩次因同樣原因失敗時，請 Claude 先找原因、換做法

done_check.title: Verify before "done" / 沒驗證就說完成時擋下
done_check.description: When Claude edited code this turn and says it's done without a passing test or check, ask it to verify or explain (docs-only edits don't count) / Claude 這一輪改了程式檔、沒跑過通過的測試或檢查就說完成時，請它先驗證或誠實說明（只改文件不算）

reply_language.title: Reply language nudge / 回覆語言提醒
reply_language.description: Remind Claude once when its explanation is mostly not in this language. auto: Claude Code's language setting; off: disabled / Claude 的說明大部分不是這個語言時提醒一次。auto＝跟著 Claude Code 的 language 設定；off＝關閉

distill.title: Auto notes / 自動整理筆記
distill.description: Write your own requests and corrections into the memory folder with a count; past 3, ask Claude to put them into the project's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md. Each pass is one background request / 把你親口說的要求與糾正整理進記憶資料夾（記次數）；講 3 次以上請 Claude 放進專案的 CLAUDE.md／AGENTS.md。每次整理是一個背景請求

distill_every.title: Notes every N messages / 每幾則訊息整理一次
distill_every.description: Update notes after this many of your messages; also before handoff and on /distill / 你送出幾則訊息後自動整理；交接前與 /distill 也會整理

notes_model.title: Notes model / 整理筆記用的模型
notes_model.description: Model for notes and guard drafts (effort low) / 整理筆記與起草守門用的模型（effort low）
